label: iPhone 14 smartphone
description: Apple iPhone 14 — 6.1-inch smartphone, Wi-Fi 6 (2x2) and 5G sub-6 GHz with mmWave on US models; adds satellite SOS, Lightning port.
notes: Wi-Fi 6 (802.11ax, 2x2, 2.4/5 GHz). Cellular: 5G sub-6 GHz + mmWave (US models), LTE Cat 18 fallback. Lightning is USB 2.0 — no wired Ethernet, hence no usb0. Satellite SOS is a non-IP path and is not modelled as an interface.
